header.title: Fragments of Theophilus
header.author: Theophilus
header.description: Greek text and English translation of the fragment of Theophilus preserved in Alexander Polyhistor ap. Eusebius (Praeparatio Evangelica IX.34.19).

div.line: Θεόφιλος δὲ ἱστορεῖ Σολομῶνα τὸν βασιλέα πέμψαι τῷ Τυρίων βασιλεῖ εἰκόνα χρυσῆν, ἀνθʼ ἧς ἐκεῖνον περιθεῖναι τῷ ναῷ κίονα χρυσοῦν, ὃν καὶ ἐπικληθῆναι Χρυσοῦν Κίονα. (Alexander Polyhistor ap. Euseb. Praep. Evang. IX.34.19)

Theophilus relates that King Solomon sent to the king of the Tyrians a golden image, in return for which the latter overlaid a pillar for the Temple with gold, which was also named the Golden Pillar. (Alexander Polyhistor ap. Eusebius, Praep. Evang. IX.34.19)
